[[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]]'s [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was '''ambushed''' by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel|scout vessel]]. The general was captured during the battle, but inflicted enough damage on the [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] to require the [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|captain]] to limp the vessel to the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on [[Flankers]].

==The battle==
While on route to a secret rendezvous with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|high command]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]]'s [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was ambushed by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel|scout vessel]]. The [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship's]] initial attack heavily damaged Reekeene's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and took out her [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]].<ref name="Missing" />

Reekeene counter-attacked, surprising the Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|commander]] who had expected the Rebel to surrender. Reekeene released a volley of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at close range into the scout ship, scoring three direct hits and blowing up the vessel's [[Fuel pod/Legends|fuel pod]]. The scout vessel was damaged, but Reekeene's fighter was too close and was disabled by flying shrapnel. The Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]] recovered Reekeene's ship, taking her [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. However, due to the damage sustained in the battle, the commander was forced to divert his ship to the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Flankers]].<ref name="Missing" />
